label: invented example
pipeline_position: Variant calling or imputation, before analysis

columns_or_fields.name: POS
columns_or_fields.meaning: One-based position of the first reference base.

columns_or_fields.name: REF
columns_or_fields.meaning: Reference allele in this invented example.

columns_or_fields.name: ALT
columns_or_fields.meaning: Alternative allele, or a symbolic allele such as NON_REF.

columns_or_fields.name: QUAL
columns_or_fields.meaning: Variant quality score, a dot when not supplied.

columns_or_fields.name: FILTER
columns_or_fields.meaning: PASS denotes no failed example filter.

columns_or_fields.name: INFO
columns_or_fields.meaning: Site annotations, including END or R2 when declared in the header.

columns_or_fields.name: FORMAT
columns_or_fields.meaning: Names and order of the sample fields.

columns_or_fields.name: S1-S4
columns_or_fields.meaning: Sample values follow FORMAT; the gVCF contains only S1.

columns_or_fields.name: GT
columns_or_fields.meaning: Genotype allele indices, where 0 is REF, 1 is the first ALT, and a dot is missing.

header_notes: The literal invented example label is in this JSON and in native comments where supported; strict formats use JSON only.
Coordinates resemble GRCh38 but alleles and positions are invented, not reference-validated.
Double-hash lines declare metadata; the single-hash CHROM line names columns.
PASS and dot values here do not establish biological validity.
